name: Tenshi no Hitomi ~Sapphire Eye~
source:
Katsumi is high school second year student. One day a lightning hits him and once he wakes up a strange phenomenon occurs to his left eye - when he watches with it on any girl, the girl becomes lustful. Later he discovers it is a technology from the future and himself also becomes the key to the survival of all humankind.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-april-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
克己是高中二年级学生。有一天，一道闪电击中了他，当他醒来时，他的左眼出现了一种奇怪的现象——当他用它看任何女孩时，女孩就会变得好色。后来他发现这是一项来自未来的技术，而他自己也成为了全人类生存的关键。

[编辑自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-april-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
